experimentDesign.status: design only; executable batch resource limits and immutable fixture hashes must be sealed before paid start
experimentDesign.primaryCausalContrast: candidate/current within each exact CLI/model/effort; native anchors product overhead
experimentDesign.independentUnit: Independent matched block containing three separately continuous sessions; comparisons and any resampling preserve block membership, not rounds or individual HTTP requests.
experimentDesign.inference: Report each binding separately; no pooled five-CLI ratio. Six blocks exploratory, not guaranteed statistical power. Model failures and environment blockers remain visible. No performance conclusion from unavailable bindings.
metrics: late rounds 7-12 separately without omitting startup
experimentDesign.failurePolicy: Keep fixed slot identities, no replacement/rerun. Incomplete or missing-usage arms have no full ratio; keep measured subtotal. Other independent slots proceed only after exact owned-process cleanup and evidence capture.
experimentDesign.nativeControl: Same native model/effort; automatic memory verified off at every launch/resume; same-session history retained.
experimentDesign.falsification: If candidate has no reproducible advantage across examined bindings, or lowers quality/reliability, do not promote the semantic hypothesis to a cost fix. A differing direction is reported, not tuned per CLI.
experimentDesign.limits: One task family cannot establish general collaboration value; paid test package still requires independent admission review, without reasking owner authorization already given.
experimentDesign.completePrimary: A planned whole-binding primary requires all six fixed blocks with complete comparable arms. Otherwise retain failures and known costs, publish partial/subset descriptions explicitly, never replace slots.
experimentDesign.roundScheduling: Within-block arm and round scheduling must be explicitly fixed in the executable manifest; the listed six orders alone do not define interleaving.

releaseBoundary: Private candidate static checks are not actual CLI or model acceptance. Formal source, service and trial flags unchanged in this research batch.
